geeklist.title: 2022 Dice Tower East Convention Virtual Flea Market
geeklist.description:
[b]Thank-you for a successful VFM.[/b] Enjoy the rest of your convention. Looking forward to seeing everyone again in 2023.
Every VFM suffers from a handful of no-shows during the Exchange, most are resolved during the con. Please use your contact information, if the seller/buyer remains unresponsive [b][url=https://boardgamegeek.com/geekmail/compose?touser=StormbringerGrey]send me[/url][/b] the contact info.
[size=18][b]Sellers, one last task: Please Pay the BGG Commission.[/b][/size]
• Per BGG’s TOS, sellers are required to pay BGG 3% commission for the use of this list. • There is no specific deadline for payment. Most payments are made during the week following the convention. • Create a [b][url=https://boardgamegeek.com/geekmarket?pageid=1]BGG Classic Market Place[/url][/b] Sale Item using "Miscellaneous Game Merchandise” (it will still work if you have already used another dummy item name). • Put "DTE 2022 VFM" in the item notes. • Use the total price of all your completed sales. • The other item details do not matter, fill them in if you wish (or not). • [b][url=https://boardgamegeek.com/geekmail/compose?touser=StormbringerGrey]Send the link to me[/url][/b] and I will “buy” your Market Place item • After you have received your confirmation from my purchase, go back to the Geek Market menu, click on "Commissions" and then "Pay Commission". (your fee may take some time to post, check back in an hour if there's nothing listed) • Advanced sellers may create individual market place items for each game sold rather than combining all sales into a single dummy transaction. This has the advantage of creating a more detailed history for the seller and supports better market statistics for each game, but takes more time for the seller. • Please be aware BGG admin can, and probably will, request a list of all sellers within a few days of the con's end. • Make sure you use the [b][url=https://boardgamegeek.com/geekmarket?pageid=1]BGG Classic Market Place[/url][/b] for a 3% commission, using the Beta Market Place will result in a 6% commission charge.
[b]Important Links[/b] [thread=2849990][b]VFM Admin Thread[/b][/thread] [url=https://www.yulgame.com/Vfm/Items/298511][b]VFM Alphabetical List 1[/b][/url] [user=Carnage994]Eric Bettan[/user] version. [url=http://bgg.activityclub.org/tools/vfm.html?listid=298511][b]VFM Alphabetical List 2[/b][/url] [user=JeffyJeff]Jeff Michaud[/user] version.
[b]Please note:[/b] This GeekList will no longer be moderated except for the purpose of assisting with commission payments.

[b]Important: For VFM Auctions, a bid at or above the starting bid is a binding offer. Deletion of a bid is a serious violation of the ToS and will result in a user's removal from the VFM event and referral to convention management for possible additional action.[/b] We get that things happen, maybe your travel plans have changed and you are no longer attending the con, in these cases contact the item seller and try to work it out, contact me as a last resort, but let me be clear,[b] withdrawing an offer because the same item turned up cheaper somewhere else or with no explanation at all will result in administrative action.[/b] See the [thread=2849990][b]VFM Admin Thread[/b][/thread] for further discussion.

I agree with everything you just said, but I will say that I find the auctions which span two months littered about a ~3,000 item list to be pretty inconvenient as a buyer. I don't want to put a bid in on something and not know until July 3rd whether I'm winning it or not. Not to mention, very few that I've seen have any sort of anti-sniping rules in place. Why would I bid on something, wait two months, only to be sniped at the literal last second? I'm almost exclusive ignoring the auction listings, unless I happen to like the BIN price. I think it would make more sense (and probably attract more visibility) for users with quite a few auction items to host their own DTE pickup auction via a geeklist. It just seems like we have two very different processes shoe-horned into the same massive list and it's not doing buyers or sellers many favors.

Hi Folks, I am going to answer a couple questions here all at once. For any follow up or further discussion please use the [thread=2849990][b]VFM Admin Thread[/b][/thread] so that we stop pinging the main GeekList.
[b]Have any wishes been fulfilled from the Wish List?[/b] Yes, I know of at least a few sales & offers that were facilitated through use of the Wish List. The likelihood of a wish being fulfilled has a lot to do with how realistic the wish was in the first place, even some of my own inquiries are a stretch to say the least but there's no harm in asking.
[b]Can I change the selling terms of an item with no offers or bids?[/b] Yes, you can do anything you like to an item that has no offers or bids.
[b]Can I change the selling terms of an item with offers or bids?[/b] Maybe. While I wouldn't recommend making a habit of it, if its done fairly, is in the best interest of the buyers, and no one objects, I am not going to get involved. Many people are doing this for the first time and better practices are learned as the list matures.
[b]What's up with auctions?[/b] Auctions have long been a part of VFMs and the selling format is here to stay. My role as admin is to make sure they are executed fairly, my opinion on their use is only one opinion among many. I have shared my opinion from a participant perspective on the [thread=2849990][b]VFM Admin Thread[/b][/thread] and encourage others to do the same but lets please keep the main GeekList as free from policy debates as possible.

The following issue has come up several times, the [thread=2849990][b]VFM Admin Thread[/b][/thread] has been updated to provide clarity (please direct any comments or questions to the admin thread) :
[b]Buying[/b] • When asking a seller a question please be clear if you are making a conditional offer to buy. For example; posting "I will BIN if this is version 2" shows clear intent to make an offer and will reserve your priority to buy pending an answer to your question. Simply asking "Is this version 2?" is not a conditional offer to buy and does not place a hold on the item pending an answer.

The VFM has no cutoff date for buying and selling, however, the [thread=2849990][b]VFM Admin Thread[/b][/thread] has been updated with guidance for managing late offers. These guidelines will take effect Wednesday, June 22nd. The VFM header will also be updated with more detail on the Exchange at that time.
[q][b]Managing late offers & the VFM end:[/b] • The VFM has no cutoff date for buying and selling, [b]HOWEVER[/b]... • A late offer is a BIN or Starting Bid made 2 weeks or less before the Exchange date • A late offer is not binding on the seller and does not guarantee a sale. Buyers should confirm item availability when making a late offer. • The late offer rules do not apply to auctions with defined end dates (this should be all auctions). • Sellers that intend to stop accepting offers more than 2 weeks before the Exchange date should indicate their last day to accept offers in their listing. [/q]

Here's some "helpful" advice.
1. Don't advertise that you have $a ton of money on you. 2. Plan on meeting some people OUTSIDE of the VFM for those that do not partake in the chaos of the VFM. 3. MAKE a HUGE sign with your name on it for the VFM... most people will be selling and looking for their buyers. 4. Plan on how you are paying --- I find creating envelopes with specific amounts in it with the name of the seller on the envelope helps. Of course some people will accept paypal (friends and family). 5. Email EVERYBODY you are buying from with the list of the games you are buying and the $ final cost and ask them what payment they prefer and if they are planning on going to the VFM. 6. You need to bring some sort of carrying device (are you driving? Bring a childs wagon - if you are buying more than you can carry - or something to help lug games out) 7. Make sure to get every seller's phone number if they allow it to text in case the VFM goes awry. I always have one or two sales/purchases go south due to someone not being there.
Tom.

All good advice. I'd also suggest that your sign has a large image of BGG avatar on it. Use your BGG user name and real name on it. I print it on 8.5X11. I attach it to a free paint stirrer I get from Lowes or HD. You can affix it how you like--tape, blue tac, glue, staples, welder's torch and solder.

[q="JohnnyC1971"]Is that image posted in the Final Stretch notice an example, or are we getting assigned locations/tables?[/q] We won't be using strict alpha order but we will have rows labeled as above and will [b]strongly[/b] encourage anyone that wants/needs table space to pick the row matching their BGG user name to make themselves easier to find. The four names shown on the diagram are VFM users that are selling and/or buying 80 or more games and they might be pre-seated (the next closest cluster is in the low 50's). These numbers were current as of last night and won't be updated. Each table has a capacity of 60-70 games if stacked efficiently (240-280 games per row). The alpha assignments shown distribute the potential game loading roughly evenly over the rows (approximately 150 games/row, well below capacity). These calculations also assume anyone buy/selling 4 games or less probably doesn't need or want table space.

[q="tribefan07"][q="KingdmHeartsFan"]Someone deleted several of their listings and it is messing me up.😱[/q] Yeah, I just noticed that as well. [/q] Hey Folks, this is serious. Hey folks, just a reminder while people are still paying attention... [b]The header will be updated one last time after the con with instructions for paying the 3% BGG sales commission[/b] (applies to sellers only). Since it has been asked before, there is no set time for paying the commission, however, don't pay before you have an accurate accounting of how much you collected. About 80% of commissions are paid in the week following the con. [b]To be absolutely clear; this commission is required by BGG for use of their platform, no fees or commissions are charged by DTE.[/b]
Just FYI, BGG is transitioning to a new GeekMarket with enhanced purchasing features, the new market also comes with an enhanced commission rate of 6% 🤔 This VFM will use the classic GeekMarket method of paying commissions (or a work-around if the classic market is decommissioned), it is not clear if future VFM's will be subject to the rate hike (VFM's don't use any of the features on the new platform so there has been some pushback from admins). Please direct any questions or comments to the [thread=2849990][b]VFM Admin Thread[/b][/thread].

Frankenstein Edition - Read Closely
This starts with the first edition card set with the cards that were not reprinted in second edition [u]removed[/u].
This includes the [b][thing=209357]Dominion: Update Pack[/thing][/b] still in shrink.
It does not include rules, you can download an encyclopedic version [geekurl=/filepage/131854/complete-rules-dominion-and-all-its-expansions]here[/geekurl]
The whole thing is then packed in a damaged 2nd edition box (see below)
[b]So, in the end, what am I getting?[/b] Assuming you download the rules, a playable copy of Dominion with 2nd Edition card manifest but first edition art on money and lands.
[b]BIN:[/b] $15
[b]Sold to:[/b][user=tls8891][/user]
[b]Why would I buy this?[/b]
- You really just want the Update Pack and will probably throw the rest away - You have played Dominion, like it enough to buy it, but don't want to pay MSRP for a 13 year old game - Your favorite nephew wants to borrow one of your games for a chicken wings and Cheetos party - You didn't read any of the above and are under the mistaken impression this is a retail version of 2nd Edition

[b]Very Important:[/b] The base game and upgrade kit are available now, however, the Gambler's Chest & First Hero expansions have not been released. They are years behind in production, probably have a year or more to go but who can tell. Adam Poots has a reputation for always being [u]very[/u] late (by years) but has not defaulted on a project yet. These expansions still receive periodic updates.
If you are interested do your research and understand what you're getting into. You will get the base game and upgrade kit at the con, I will ship the expansions [u]at your cost[/u] when they arrive, or, who knows, maybe I can hand deliver at DTE 2023, or 2024, or 2025. If the pledge manager reopens for address corrections during the shipping phase I may be able to redirect. These will be worth a small fortune when (if?) they deliver, I am offering the package for less than I paid during the campaign.
[b]To be absolutely clear:[/b] I [u][b]WILL NOT[/b][/u] provide a refund in the unlikely chance Adam does not produce a product, however, even in this unlikely event you will have the base game and upgrade pack at close to retail.

This game has the same kind of "choose when to switch gears" mechanic as Flotilla and to a lesser extent, Dominion. You can collect potential points all game but if you wait too long to start scoring them, then they aren't worth anything. But once you start scoring, there's no turning back. So when do you flip?

New in shrink (NIS). Orlando-based designers and I had the good fortune of being able to play it as it was being developed. It has a Concordia card-action system with the hook of flipping from "Sinkside" powers to "Skyside" powers once per game. The distribution of Sinkside vs. Skyside players really changes up the game's economy, so it may be beneficial to you to never flip while everyone else competes for the things available to skyside players. Innovative game. I hope they get an expansion out.
Please no haggling. I determined price by either a discount off the GameNerdz price available and the most comparable recent GeekMarket sale if not. Timeline with numerous expansions.

A beautiful and beautifully simple game of laying a tile before your own token to continue its path on each turn. The goal is to keep your token on the board longer than anyone else's, but as the board fills up this becomes harder because there are fewer empty spaces left... and another player's tile may also extend your own path in a direction you'd rather not go.

It has two trays for the tokens that you can take out and lay on the table for play and one stabilizer rectangle to fill the bottom of the box evenly (just the four sides, no bottom) that the cards in baggies and dice in a bag too. I don't think the game has been played, the cards feel new, but it is punched and ready to play.[imageid=6935713]

[b]WITHDRAWN[/b]

[-]This is a unique listing so be sure to read on!
First of all this game is SUPER well organized and it definitely needs it getting this game to fit in the box without a proper organizer is very difficult. The organizer is just something I 3D printed, but the pattern greatly reduces set up and has a separate box for each players pieces. It is also organized with the printable tuck boxes available from BGG to download and print.
Additionally, you will be getting 1.5 copies of the game. Part way through our campaign there was a tragic drink spilling incident so we had to buy a second copy to finish out campaign. Due to this you will have two copies of many components including the miniatures, the secret tuckbox items, the rulebooks, scenario books etc. pretty much anything that would hold up to a spill.
We did use one copy of map and stickers, but there is still a fresh set from the second copy. [/-]

item.comment: Hey, all. When someone writes "BIN", does that mean they bought it? I assume yes but I've never done this and don't want to mess anyone up

Ok, I'm definitely interested but need to sell some more stuff, hopefully, first. If I sell some more stuff, or there's any of my stuff you're interested in doing a partial trade let me know, I will definitely be checking on this!
Yeah, I'm gonna hit you up in a PM. We can talk.

Bit more info: 1st ed [u]doesn't need a companion app[/u] (required with 2nd ed), allowing for different experience from 2nd ed. For people who already own 2e, this can be incorporated to add the original characters and monsters into the game (instead of purchasing the [u]Recurring Nightmares 2e expansion[/u] which is also oop and frequently more expensive than a 1st ed core game, so save some money). [u]1st edition allows for a 1 versus many way to play, where 2e is full co-op.[/u]
Pick up at the Exchange Preferred. I'm volunteering at the Con, so my availability is limited. Any $2 promo or game I list is 3/$5, or 1 free with a $20 purchase, so check back frequently, I'll be listing for a couple days.

item.comment: Can you tell me a little more about the condition? Thank yoi!
We’ve played the base game about 3-4 times and the expansions 1-2 times. Everything is in excellent shape. A few of the ship log sheets have been used, but there are plenty left. Smoke-free home.
We’re interested, but, Since this is a legacy/campaign style game, have you placed any stickers or otherwise made any permanent changes to the game?

No. There isn’t anything like that in this game. You have a log sheet for each time through the campaign, but there are plenty of them (and they are meant to be used and disposed of). There are no stickers. The cards do not get ripped up; rather they get removed and put back. Ours are in the original order.
Also, if you do buy the game, I recommend you play with the expansions from the start. We bought them later and tried to add them in and it didn’t work so well. We hardly used/saw any of the Dungeon stuff.

item.comment: I already have this game. Any way you would split up the expansion and promos and sell them separately?
I only played the game once, before backing the expansion, and then realized I didn't care for it, so I'd like to sell it complete. But I'd sell it for $50 if you want to them sell the base game. :)
By the way, the Cold War expansion from Kickstarter has the Mexico and Missile Crisis promo cards included. So you probably have two of those!
Had no idea, lol. That's cool they did that. Looks like the base game is going for $60 itself on bgg market. So I think doing $50 for all of it is a good deal. :)

[q="steckman"]By the way, the Cold War expansion from Kickstarter has the Mexico and Missile Crisis promo cards included. So you probably have two of those![/q] This is a good point. Is this the kickstarter Cold War expansion? If so would you be willing to sell just that?
Yeah it just delivered from the KS. I'm going to keep it bundled as I think that would be easier for me to sell, if not on the VFM, then later.
Ok let me know if you change your mind.
Lol let me know if you change your mind again. :)

[q="Lividentity"]Lol let me know if you change your mind again. :)[/q]
I'll take this for $50 if there are no deals happening above.

This is the huuuuuuge Kickstarter edition. Let me say that again. This game is HUGE. Please don't bid on this item unless you have some way to get it home. Mint in shrink.
Fine Print Please Read
I WILL NOT be attending the two game exchange. Why? The game exchange is a chaotic waste of time in the middle of the con. The good news? I will literally track you down and bring you your game instead. Just make sure I have your cell, and like the dude from the Taken movie, although in a much less scary and murderous way, I will find you during the con. I've done this for years, and it works great. If you have a problem having your game hand-delivered to you, just don't buy from me. Thanks!
After having three people in previous years buy things, then back out before payment at the con, I am instituting the following rule: if you post that you wish to purchase an item, you are legally binding yourself to pay for the item. If you buy, and elect not to pay me for any reason (friend bought the same game, discovered game in ancient cave, decided to give up games for a life or Trappist simplicity, etc.), then you agree to give me a ten dollar bill when I track you down at Dice Tower Con. In other words, don't be a jerk. Don't buy something unless you want it. If you buy an item, please pay me for it. Thanks.
Price $80

I WILL NOT be attending the two game exchange. Why? The game exchange is a chaotic waste of time in the middle of the con. The good news? I will literally track you down and bring you your game instead. Just make sure I have your cell, and like the dude from the Taken movie, although in a much less scary and murderous way, I will find you during the con. I've done this for years, and it works great. If you have a problem having your game hand-delivered to you, just don't buy from me. Thanks!
After having three people in previous years buy things, then back out before payment at the con, I am instituting the following rule: if you post that you wish to purchase an item, you are legally binding yourself to pay for the item. If you buy, and elect not to pay me for any reason (friend bought the same game, discovered game in ancient cave, decided to give up games for a life or Trappist simplicity, etc.), then you agree to give me a ten dollar bill when I track you down at Dice Tower Con. In other words, don't be a jerk. Don't buy something unless you want it. If you buy an item, please pay me for it. Thanks.

item.comment: Aaron: you say "Recommend owning 2 copies to combine and create proper 30 card decks with elite heroes." Will two copies be enough to create proper decks and elite heroes for two people? I thought so, but since you are making recommendations, I thought I would ask for more info. Thanks!

Peter, It will make sense when you read the instructions. The 2 player game set comes with two 20 card decks. Each card that needs dice comes with its own matching die. (not all cards use dice, instant effects and such). A standard game uses 30 card decks. Also in order to use the elite versions of the heroes you need to own 2 copies of their dice. Elite heroes get to roll 2 dice instead of 1. So by purchasing 2 of the starter sets you will now have 2 of every die/card. You can take the two 20 card decks and combine them to create a standard 30 card deck. (remove your 10 least favorite cards) And since you have 2 of every die you can use the elite heroes. I own 2 of these sets myself and the decks are quite powerful when 2 sets are combined together.
Thanks so much for the info!

I’ll take 2 blacks . I also kickstarted it and could use more for my magic and KeyForge decks. What size inside boxes do they come with? I prefer the longest ones. Any idea why they closed?

@Ryan S @Ohami is purchasing them all but if for some reason he doesn't get them I will let you know. It was very sad that they weren't able to continue the business. I intended on buying more of them over time and eventually using them 100% as my game storage solution. But I was only able ever to get 4 before they went under. I think it was a hard sell for a lot of people because they like to display the game boxes. But if storage space was an issue this solution was great!

[-]Kickstarter Edition. Used in excellent condition. Complete with all Kickstarter extras, expansions, and promos.
Important note! Some of the boards are warped and the scorpion miniature has a piece broken. This is shown in the pictures. I am confident that these issues can be resolved with some care and patience based on similar problems I have had with other games in my collection. I would recommend applying heat to the boards via something like a hair blow dryer and then simply placing weight on the boards (like heavy textbooks) and letting gravity set them back in place after a day or two. The scorpion should be easily fixed with some carefully placed super glue.

item.comment: Hi Mike, sorry you can't make it. Strictly speaking, selling DTE items such as tickets, parking passes, rooms, etc.. is against the ToS. It may sound unreasonable but we had an issue a few years back with someone selling rooms and parking passes at a profit. I am sure that's not the case here and this is effectively the last day of the VFM so I'll let it stand, just please don't sell it at a profit. FYI... you may find a wider audience on the Facebook group.

Oops, I missed that in the ToS. Sorry about that. I'll take it down now. Definitely wasn't going to be for profit!
I did post in the Facebook group too.
